自动：有代理时使用远程加密DNS，无代理时使用系统DNS。: Auto uses encrypted remote DNS with a proxy, and system DNS without one.
Bootstrap：自动使用引导DNS: Bootstrap: use the bootstrap resolver automatically
根据路由中的域名及规则集自动选择直连或代理DNS。: Choose direct or proxy DNS using domain routing rules and rule sets.
指定解析器及DNS请求出口。: Choose the resolver and DNS outbound.
缓存解析结果；FakeIP用于TUN的A/AAAA查询。: Cache responses; FakeIP handles A/AAAA queries from TUN.
域名或IP，可指定端口和路径: Domain or IP, with optional port and path
检测当前连接配置；未保存的页面设置不参与检测。: Testing the active connection; unsaved changes are excluded.
尚未连接：仅检测引导和直连DNS，代理及TUN路径未验证。: Disconnected: testing bootstrap and direct DNS only. Proxy and TUN paths are unverified.
未检测：缺少检测组件: Not tested: diagnostic component is missing
检测失败：无法运行独立网络探针: Diagnostic failed: independent network probe unavailable
检测边界：出口依据正在使用的原生配置；查询成功不等于已排除所有DNS泄漏。系统解: Limits: outbounds are taken from the active native configuration. A successful query does not rule out all DNS leaks. System resolvers may forward through system services; their final upstream IP requires a web test or packet capture.
DNS超时为1–30秒，缓存容量为1024–65536，过期容忍为1–86400: DNS timeout: 1–30 seconds; capacity: 1024–65536; stale grace: 1–86400 seconds.
DNS出站节点不存在: DNS outbound node does not exist
正在使用的DNS出站节点不能修改或删除: The active DNS outbound node cannot be edited or deleted.
已还原默认DNS设置，点击保存生效: DNS defaults restored. Save to apply.
所有进程RSS合计: Total RSS of all application processes
保存节点及订阅，含连接凭据。: Save nodes and subscriptions, including credentials.
只保存当前启用的路由规则及自定义规则。: Save only the active routing configuration and custom rules.
保存当前DNS设置，不包含节点及路由规则。: Save DNS settings only, without nodes or routing rules.
每类最多保留5份；还原仅替换当前分类的数据。: Keep up to 5 per category. Restoring replaces only that category.
创建此分类的第一份备份。: Create your first backup in this category.
还原此备份将替换当前%s，是否继续？: Restore this backup and replace the current %s?
此类备份已达%d份，继续将覆盖最早的备份，是否继续？: This category already has %d backups. Replace the oldest one?
还原后DNS出站节点不存在，请先调整DNS出口或还原对应节点: The restored configuration would lose the DNS outbound node. Change the DNS outbound or restore that node first.
还原此备份将替换当前节点，是否继续？: Restore this backup and replace the current nodes and subscriptions?
还原此备份将替换当前路由规则，是否继续？: Restore this backup and replace the current routing rules?
还原此备份将替换当前DNS设置，是否继续？: Restore this backup and replace the current DNS settings?
HTTP与SOCKS5共用此端口。: HTTP and SOCKS5 share this port.
关闭时仅本机可连接；开启后使用本机局域网IP和代理端口连接。: When off, only this device can connect. When on, use this device’s LAN IP and proxy port.
通过前置代理连接节点；直连流量不经过它。: Connect to nodes through the upstream proxy. Direct traffic bypasses it.
HTTP前置代理支持TCP；UDP协议需使用支持UDP的SOCKS5前置代理。: HTTP upstream proxies support TCP. UDP requires a SOCKS5 upstream proxy with UDP support.
请填写代理用户和密码: Enter the proxy username and password.
代理用户和密码最长255字节，用户不能包含冒号或控制字符: Proxy credentials must not exceed 255 bytes. Usernames cannot contain colons or control characters.
请填写有效的前置代理地址: Enter a valid upstream proxy address.
前置代理不能指向本地代理自身: The upstream proxy cannot point to this local proxy.
HTTP前置代理不支持UDP，请改用支持UDP的SOCKS5前置代理: HTTP upstream proxies do not support UDP. Use a SOCKS5 upstream proxy with UDP support.
此节点使用UDP传输，HTTP前置代理不支持UDP，请改用支持UDP的SOCKS: This node uses UDP transport. Use a SOCKS5 upstream proxy with UDP support instead of HTTP.
FakeTCP不能通过前置代理，请改用UDP传输: FakeTCP cannot use an upstream proxy. Switch to UDP transport.
测试URL需为有效的HTTP/HTTPS地址: Enter a valid HTTP/HTTPS test URL
在浏览器中打开所选测速URL。: Open the selected speed test URL in your browser.
TCP检测节点握手；ICMP检测节点网络往返；CONNECT通过节点请求测试UR: TCP measures a node handshake; ICMP measures network round trips; CONNECT requests the test URL through the node. UDP protocols use protocol requests in TCP mode.
节点未指定指纹时使用此设置；节点自己的指纹设置优先。: Used when a node has no explicit fingerprint. The node fingerprint takes precedence.
留空则允许所有端口，0则禁止所有端口: Leave blank to allow all ports; 0 blocks all ports.
如果开启中继则使用规则配置转发UDP流量，否则全部直连转发UDP流量: When relay is enabled, UDP follows routing rules. Otherwise all UDP is forwarded directly.
开启此选项可以防止WebRTC泄漏真实IP: Block STUN to prevent WebRTC from revealing your real IP.
现在仅Shadowsocks、ShadowsocksR、Socks5、Socks: UDP relay currently supports Shadowsocks, ShadowsocksR, SOCKS5, SOCKS5 over TLS, VMess, Hysteria, Hysteria2, Relay, Trojan and VLESS.
运行端口需为1–65535、端口范围或逗号分隔的列表；0表示全部禁止: Enter ports 1–65535, ranges or a comma-separated list; 0 blocks all ports.
*现在仅Shadowsocks、ShadowsocksR、Socks5、Sock: *UDP relay currently supports Shadowsocks, ShadowsocksR, SOCKS5, SOCKS5 over TLS, VMess, Hysteria, Hysteria2, Relay, Trojan and VLESS.
最多显示200项，请搜索以缩小范围: Showing up to 200 items. Search to narrow the list.
规则已变化，请重新打开: Rules changed. Open the editor again.
测试端口或网络协议无效: Invalid test port or network protocol
规则策略对应的节点或分组不存在：%s: Rule target node or group does not exist: %s
代理分组成员或测试URL无效: Invalid proxy group members or test URL
所选策略不在分组内: Selected policy is not a group member
需要测试IP规则时，请填写目标IP: Enter the destination IP when testing IP rules.
自动匹配根据系统语言和时区推测国家和地区。: Automatic selection estimates the region from system language and time zone.
兼容Clash、V2ray/V2fly、Sing-box、Shadowsocks: Supports Clash, V2ray/V2fly, Sing-box, Shadowsocks, Sub, Github and Karing subscriptions.
订阅地址必须是有效的 HTTP 或 HTTPS URL: The subscription address must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
请求内容仅记录前64KiB，转发内容完整: Only the first 64KiB is logged; forwarding is complete.
请求未完整发送: The request was not fully sent.
连接元数据：加密流量无法读取完整URL、请求头和正文: Connection metadata: encrypted URLs, headers and bodies are not readable.
清空代理日志、DNS日志和应用日志？: Clear proxy, DNS and app logs?
每个连接结束时记录目标、匹配规则、出站、耗时和流量；被拒绝或失败的连接立即记录: Records each connection's destination, matched rule, outbound, duration and traffic when it ends; rejected or failed connections are recorded immediately
另记录明文HTTP请求的请求头和正文（最多64KiB）；HTTPS内容无法读取: Also records headers and bodies of plaintext HTTP requests (up to 64 KiB); HTTPS content cannot be read
记录每次DNS查询的域名、类型、结果和耗时: Records the domain, type, result and time of each DNS query
超过保留天数的代理、DNS和应用日志会被删除: Proxy, DNS and app logs older than the retention period are deleted
